We need DBE for C11H11O2Cl. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (halogens count as H). O ignored. For halogen, treat as H. So effective H = H + halogen count = 11 + 1 =12. No N. So DBE = C - (H_eff)/2 +1 = 11 - 12/2 +1 = 11 -6 +1 =6. So integer 6.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. But to follow process, maybe call retrieve_dbe_formula. Let's do that.
